Definition: from G2968 and G4172; an unwalled city:--town.
BiblicalUsage: Komopolis is a town, an unwalled city. Mark 1:38 has Jesus saying, let us go into the next towns, that I may preach there also, for therefore came I forth.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the next towns are the whole mission: Jesus came forth to preach, and He would not stay where the crowd wanted Him to stay.
